title: Elastic and OpenAI collaborate to bring frontier intelligence to unstructured enterprise data
description: Today, we announced an expanded collaboration to bridge the gap between AI agents and the enterprise context they need, helping organizations build production-ready AI applications and agents using OpenAI models with Elasticsearch.

title: Understanding the approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) algorithm
description: Discover the power of approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) algorithms. ANN search is the key to lightning-fast searches and valuable insights in vast data landscapes.

title: Vector database vs. graph database: Understanding the differences
description: Discover the differences and similarities between knowledge graph and vector databases in this comprehensive guide. Explore their definitions and ideal use cases, and make an informed decision on which one to choose.

title: Elastic and Cursor partner to accelerate context engineering with coding agents
description: Elastic and Cursor partner to bring Elasticsearch's retrieval, tools, and memory into Cursor's coding agents, giving developers a context engineering foundation that keeps AI grounded in their own data.

title: Elastic Cloud Serverless: Ongoing multicontinent expansion
description: Elastic announces the availability of Elastic Cloud Serverless in two additional Azure regions and two additional Google Cloud regions. Elastic meets customers where their data is — all around the globe.

title: Elastic achieves the AWS AI Security Distinction, securing AI-specific risks
description: Elastic has achieved the AWS AI Security Distinction, awarded to partners with tech depth and real customer outcomes in AI and security. Elastic Security includes an AI agent, Elastic Workflows, LLM security detections, and agentic SOC capabilities.

title: From tool procurement to platform architecture: Rethinking the SOC for machine-speed threats
description: Fragmented SOCs can't keep pace with AI-driven attacks. See why security teams are moving from point tools to open, unified, agentic platforms in 2026.

title: How Elastic AI Assistant for Security and Amazon Bedrock can empower security analysts for enhanced performance
description: The Elastic AI Assistant for Security coupled with Anthropic’s Claude model via Amazon Bedrock can elevate a security team’s posture and eliminate mundane tasks.

title: Elastic joins NVIDIA and industry leaders as inaugural member of the Open Secure AI Alliance for AI safety and security
description: NVIDIA, Elastic, and other industry leaders are founding members of an innovative movement building tools to advance open innovation, shared progress, and trust in AI.

title: The big ideas behind retrieval augmented generation
description: In this post, I focus on the big ideas behind vectors, chunking, and RAG. These complicated concepts are explained in detail through easy-to-understand analogies and examples for a less technical audience to get started on semantic search.

title: The evolution of Discover in Kibana
description: Discover has been around for quite some time in Kibana. But recently, we've added a new document table, field statistics, and the ability to create threshold alert rules.

title: Streamline Kibana dashboard navigation with the Links panel
description: Find out how to better organize your Kibana dashboards and carry over your filters and queries when navigating between dashboards.

title: Elastic Stack 8.11: Introducing a new powerful query language, ES|QL
description: Elastic Stack 8.11 introduces an advanced query language known as ES|QL in the Discover application, making data exploration more straightforward and user friendly. The Elastic Learned Sparse EncodeR (ELSER) is now generally available.

title: Elastic Stack 8.9: Faster cross-cluster searches and aggregations on metrics
description: Elastic Stack 8.9 delivers significant speed-up of aggregations for metrics, faster and more reliable cross-cluster searches, and management of alert rules using Terraform.

title: Crafting a hybrid geospatial RAG application with Elastic and Amazon Bedrock
description: This blog explores how to build a powerful retrieval augmented generation (RAG) system that incorporates geospatial data using Elasticsearch, Amazon Bedrock, and LangChain.

title: Generative AI using Elastic and Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
description: Learn how to build a GAI solution by exploring Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, Elastic, and Hugging Face open source LLMs using the sample implementation provided in this post and a data set relevant to your business.

title: In search of a cluster health diagnosis: Introducing the Elasticsearch Health API
description: Is my Elasticsearch cluster healthy? How do I repair it? These are difficult questions to answer, but as part of Elasticsearch 8.7, we are releasing a new Health API to help identify and fix problems in Elasticsearch clusters.

title: Elasticsearch MCP server now available on AWS Marketplace
description: Elasticsearch MCP server — available on AWS Marketplace — allows seamless integration with Elasticsearch data using the Model Context Protocol. You can connect directly from any MCP-compatible client to query and interact with Elasticsearch indices.

title: Elastic and Google Cloud: Enhancing security analytics from data ingestion to incident response
description: Elastic and Google Cloud are pioneering a comprehensive security solution that leverages their distinct capabilities to offer an unparalleled security analytics experience.

title: How to build comprehensive customer financial profiles with Elastic Cloud and Google Cloud
description: Financial institutions have vast amounts of data about their customers, but many of them struggle to use that data to their advantage. Elastic and Google Cloud enable institutions to manage this information effectively.

title: Safely sample production data into pre-production environments with Logstash
description: Learn how to use Logstash to safely route a subset of production data to pre-production clusters by using efficient sampling techniques and by leveraging the UDP protocol’s fire-and-forget functionality.

title: Encryption at rest in Elastic Cloud: Bring your own key with Google Cloud
description: Follow the step-by-step process of configuring encryption at rest in Elastic Cloud using Google Cloud Key Management Service.

title: Secure your Elastic Cloud account with multifactor authentication (MFA)
description: Elastic Cloud now supports enhanced multifactor authentication (MFA) to protect user accounts and data. Learn about the importance of MFA for your organization and how to implement your MFA setup.

title: Encryption at rest in Elastic Cloud: Bring your own key with Azure Key Vault
description: Follow this step-by-step process to implement encryption at rest with Azure Key Vault keys and Elastic Cloud deployments to create a secure and compliant environment for your sensitive data.

title: Encryption at rest in Elastic Cloud: Bring your own key with AWS KMS
description: Follow the step-by-step process of configuring encryption at rest in Elastic Cloud using AWS Key Management Service (KMS).

title: Elastic Platform 8.14: ES|QL GA, encryption at rest, and vector search optimizations
description: Elastic Platform 8.14 includes ES|QL GA, the use of AI for pattern recognition in logs, API key based security model for remote clusters, encryption at rest with KMS keys, retrievers, several vector optimizations, and vector quantization by default.

title: Elastic’s new metrics capabilities will dramatically improve uptime for public sector IT
description: The new columnar metrics engine in Elastic Observability enables public sector IT teams to combine logging, metrics, and traces in one platform. As a result, SREs can improve uptime while protecting taxpayer dollars in the process.

title: Elastic and Deductive AI join forces to accelerate agentic incident investigation for engineering teams
description: Today, Elastic announced that it has entered into an agreement to acquire Deductive AI, an AI-powered investigation platform that helps engineering teams identify and resolve production issues faster.

title: Elastic Stack 9.4.3 released
description:
Version 9.4.3 of the Elastic Stack was released today. We recommend you upgrade to this latest version. We recommend 9.4.3 over the previous versions 9.4.2

For details of the issues that have been fixed and a full list of changes for each product in this version, please refer to the release notes.

title: Higher education analytics for the ultra-intelligent university
description: Learn how higher education analytics and a unified data platform help institutions break down silos and build a smarter, AI-ready university.

title: Elastic and Axonius integrate to deliver unified asset intelligence for security teams
description: The Axonius integration brings normalized asset context into Elastic, so analysts can search, correlate, and investigate Axonius data alongside endpoint alerts, network telemetry, identity events, and the rest of your Elastic Security data.

title: Elastic’s guide to AI in the interview process
description: As the Search AI Company, we understand the value of AI. We use it. We build with it. We believe in its power to augment human potential. But when you’re applying to join Elastic, we’re searching for you.

title: Elastic named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Observability Platforms
description: Elastic was named a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Observability Platforms. In our opinion, Elastic Observability helps teams investigate faster with agentic AI with full context and reduces costs with efficient metrics and logs storage.
